claim: Behavior is what focus does across the shot rather than where it starts - a rack is a dramatic beat, a reveal performed with the lens instead of a cut. Snap_focus lands attention like a slap; soft_throughout refuses to let the audience settle.
not_visual: Five of the six values are transitions between two focus states over time. Only soft_throughout is static, and it is already covered by shot.focus.dof, so a still card would show one usable panel and five duplicates of shot.focus.point.
